en.summary: Mistfall Hunter is a third-person PvPvE extraction ARPG from Bellring Games, published by Skystone Games and launching July 29, 2026 on PC, PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series X/S (day one on Xbox Game Pass). Set in Weavereach after the gods have fallen and the corrupting Gyldenmist consumes the world, players take on the role of a Gyldhunter revived by a mysterious girl named Dew, venturing solo or in three-player squads to harvest Gyldenblood and extract before death strips them of everything.

guideSections.title: The Extraction Loop
guideSections.description: Runs revolve around scavenging Gyldenblood and relics, fighting corrupted creatures and rival Gyldhunter squads, then reaching a Returner Woodling to secure a Soul of Return and extract safely — death costs you everything you were carrying, keeping every run tense.

guideSections.title: Classes & No Pay-to-Win Design
guideSections.description: Mistfall Hunter ships with six classes, seasonal content, and a stated no-pay-to-win approach; an Open Beta ran June 14–22, 2026 across Steam, Xbox Series X/S, and PlayStation ahead of launch.
